## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an exceptionally capable, farseeing, and hardworking woman who manages both her own affairs and those of others. Known as a good Christian and a red-hot politician, she holds strong religious convictions, such as viewing horse racing as an abomination. Although she possesses a kindly heart, she is also recognized as officious, critical, and nagging in her persistent efforts to urge people to do right. She prides herself on being outspoken and a shrewd judge of human nature, always eager to give advice and speak her mind without fear or favor. In addition to her notable personality traits, she is skilled at sewing and has earned a first prize for her homemade butter and cheese.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde, a prominent [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) resident who raised ten children, first learned of the Cuthberts' intention to adopt a boy when she saw [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dressed in his fine clothes and visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate, voicing strong skepticism about the decision. After the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) accidentally received [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) instead, Mrs. Rachel visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insulted Anne's looks, sparking a dramatic outburst from the young girl; however, she later accepted Anne's performance of an apology and granted her forgiveness. Over time, Mrs. Lynde provided advice to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's upbringing, such as recommending she stay home from school after a dispute, and assisted [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) by sewing a fashionable puffed-sleeve dress for Anne's [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew up, Mrs. Lynde came to admire her transformation and praised her growth, eventually joining [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) in celebrating Anne's top score on the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. Following Matthew's sudden death and the revelation of Marilla's failing eyesight, Mrs. Lynde informed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) had given up the post at the local [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could teach nearby and remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## Quotes

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "I was kind of afraid you weren’t, though, when I saw Matthew starting off today. I thought maybe he was going to the doctor’s."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "I don’t know it. I guess you’re going to teach right here in Avonlea. The trustees have decided to give you the school."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Rachel are close friends and neighbors in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who frequently visit one another, share local gossip, and travel together to events such as political rallies. Despite their strong bond, their relationship experiences occasional friction due to Rachel's outspoken nature, such as when Rachel harshly criticizes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's appearance and offends her. However, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) respects Rachel's practical wisdom and seeks her advice on practical matters, including how to handle Anne's stubborn refusal to attend school.
